Indications - In this mode an indication will be given in the question and you must pick the medicine that pertains to it. 

Category - In this mode you will pick either the brand or generic that's associated with the drug category/class mentioned in the question.

Assorted - In this mode there will be random questions picked from the quiz types mentioned above.
